title: Prompting That Gets Useful Answers
body: Use five parts to get one truthful, useful draft.
notes: Open with a first-job resume bullet.
aria: Prompting That Gets Useful Answers. Use five parts to get one truthful, useful draft.

title: Why vague prompts drift
body: “Make me impressive” invites unsupported detail.
notes: Compare outputs from the same raw note.
aria: Why vague prompts drift. “Make me impressive” invites unsupported detail.

title: Five parts
body: Use role, facts, audience, constraints and uncertainty.
notes: Explain one purpose for each part.
aria: Five parts. Use role, facts, audience, constraints and uncertainty.

title: One job, two prompts
body: Compare a vague cashier request with a five-part request.
aria: One job, two prompts. Compare a vague cashier request with a five-part request.

title: Activity: label a prompt
body: Identify the five parts in a model note.
notes: Reveal one label at a time.
aria: Activity: label a prompt. Identify the five parts in a model note.

title: Facts first
body: Supply only what happened and ask for missing details.
notes: Model a request to ask rather than guess.
aria: Facts first. Supply only what happened and ask for missing details.

title: Useful limits
body: Specify voice, length, format and no invented metrics.
notes: Choose constraints a reader can test.
aria: Useful limits. Specify voice, length, format and no invented metrics.

title: Activity: write a first prompt
body: Use fictional babysitting or cashier notes.
aria: Activity: write a first prompt. Use fictional babysitting or cashier notes.

title: Mid-quiz: three checks
body: Find a missing part, a constraint that prevents invention and the problem with impressive wording.
notes: Return to the same source notes.
aria: Mid-quiz: three checks. Find a missing part, a constraint that prevents invention and the problem with impressive wording.

title: A school pattern
body: Ask for an explanation, a quiz and feedback on your own answer if the teacher permits it.
aria: A school pattern. Ask for an explanation, a quiz and feedback on your own answer if the teacher permits it.

title: An interview pattern
body: Request one question at a time and feedback after the student answers.
notes: Do not memorize an invented story.
aria: An interview pattern. Request one question at a time and feedback after the student answers.

title: A builder pattern
body: Ask for three bullets based only on listed duties and tools.
notes: Check every line because AI can be wrong.
aria: A builder pattern. Ask for three bullets based only on listed duties and tools.

title: Screen recording: compare prompts
body: Plan an 8–10 minute demo using the same experience twice.
notes: Until recorded, annotate which prompt caused which change.
aria: Screen recording: compare prompts. Plan an 8–10 minute demo using the same experience twice.

title: Change one thing
body: Add a source fact or tighten one constraint when a draft stays generic.
aria: Change one thing. Add a source fact or tighten one constraint when a draft stays generic.

title: Activity: two edits
body: Revise a failed prompt in two deliberate steps.
aria: Activity: two edits. Revise a failed prompt in two deliberate steps.

title: What to leave out
body: Exclude passwords, identification details and other people's private information.
notes: Use general locations and sample data.
aria: What to leave out. Exclude passwords, identification details and other people's private information.

title: Worksheet: My Prompt Patterns
body: Fill in school, resume and interview templates with all five parts.
aria: Worksheet: My Prompt Patterns. Fill in school, resume and interview templates with all five parts.

title: One earned bullet
body: Use a builder draft or document to record a claim you can explain.
aria: One earned bullet. Use a builder draft or document to record a claim you can explain.

title: Common traps
body: Notice artificially adult voice, missing facts and vague praise requests.
aria: Common traps. Notice artificially adult voice, missing facts and vague praise requests.

title: Recap the five parts
body: Name what each part constrains in the answer.
notes: Use a prompt with one part removed.
aria: Recap the five parts. Name what each part constrains in the answer.

title: Next: catching errors
body: Even a strong prompt can produce an error.
aria: Next: catching errors. Even a strong prompt can produce an error.

title: Optional completion line
body: Preview a class record or a true practiced skill.
aria: Optional completion line. Preview a class record or a true practiced skill.

title: End question: identify the pattern
body: Choose the complete five-part request.
aria: End question: identify the pattern. Choose the complete five-part request.

title: End question: select a prompt
body: Compare two requests from the same student.
notes: Prefer the one grounded in real facts.
aria: End question: select a prompt. Compare two requests from the same student.

title: End question: invention risk
body: Identify the unsupported achievement in a request.
notes: Remove it or ask for evidence.
aria: End question: invention risk. Identify the unsupported achievement in a request.

title: End question: school rules
body: Choose help allowed by a stated assignment policy.
notes: Do not let a prompt override it.
aria: End question: school rules. Choose help allowed by a stated assignment policy.

title: End question: follow-up
body: Choose a revision that asks about missing evidence.
notes: Reject a request for a more flattering guess.
aria: End question: follow-up. Choose a revision that asks about missing evidence.

title: Answer review
body: Explain all five choices and allow another try.
aria: Answer review. Explain all five choices and allow another try.

title: Practice: messy note card
body: Supply an example about sorting supplies after a club event.
aria: Practice: messy note card. Supply an example about sorting supplies after a club event.

title: Practice: identify the role
body: Choose an appropriate editor role.
notes: Define its task in one sentence.
aria: Practice: identify the role. Choose an appropriate editor role.

title: Practice: extract the facts
body: Separate observed work from guessed results.
aria: Practice: extract the facts. Separate observed work from guessed results.

title: Practice: choose the reader
body: Specify the job or school audience.
aria: Practice: choose the reader. Specify the job or school audience.

title: Practice: set limits
body: Define length, voice and what must not be invented.
aria: Practice: set limits. Define length, voice and what must not be invented.

title: Practice: uncertainty check
body: Ask which details need confirmation, then trim the result.
aria: Practice: uncertainty check. Ask which details need confirmation, then trim the result.

title: Close with one draft
body: Read the line out loud and check it against the original note.
aria: Close with one draft. Read the line out loud and check it against the original note.

title: Take the facts forward
body: Use real notes the next time you start a prompt.
aria: Take the facts forward. Use real notes the next time you start a prompt.
